headline: Goa to Host IPL 2027 Mini-Auction
summary: The Indian Premier League auction is returning to India, with Goa selected to host the 2027 edition in December. Officials have confirmed the event will take place in mid-December.

headline: Hotels and Sweet Shops Must Declare Milk Analogue
summary: The Food and Drug Administration has mandated that all hotels and sweet shops must clearly declare the use of milk analogues. Establishments failing to comply will face strict regulatory action.

headline: FDA Issues Guidelines on Beef Storage
summary: The FDA has stated that beef must be stored in cold storage facilities. Only brief hanging of the meat is permitted under the new directives.

headline: Glenmark Pharma Receives US FDA EIR for Goa Plant
summary: Glenmark Pharmaceuticals has received the Establishment Inspection Report from the US FDA for its Goa facility. The inspection was successfully closed with Voluntary Action Indicated status.

headline: 'Enough is Enough' Pushes for Good Candidates
summary: The 'Enough is Enough' movement is urging Goans to pressure political parties to field better candidates. The group is holding outreach events across regions like Margao and Mapusa.

headline: Elderly Sisters Found Dead in Canacona
summary: Two elderly sisters were found dead at their home in Canacona in a double tragedy. A police probe revealed that the pair had meticulously saved money for their own funeral rites.

headline: Yuvraj Singh's Goa Villa Open to Guests
summary: Former cricketer Yuvraj Singh's four-bedroom sea-view villa in Goa is now open for holiday rentals. Details regarding the nightly stay costs have been made public.

headline: Sunset Homes Aids Goa Real Estate Buyers
summary: Sunset Homes India is assisting property buyers in navigating the real estate market in Goa. The firm helps clients select the most suitable housing projects.

headline: National CVD Summit 2026 to Focus on Cardiac Care
summary: The Government of Goa and Tricog Health are partnering to convene the National CVD Summit 2026. The event aims to advance scalable cardiac healthcare solutions in the region.

headline: Goa Adopts Adult Vaccination Policy
summary: Health Minister Vishwajit Rane announced that Goa has officially become the first state in India to adopt an adult vaccination policy. The initiative aims to enhance public health safeguards.

headline: 47 Indian Hotels Awarded Michelin Keys
summary: Forty-seven hotels across India, spanning from Goa to Rajasthan, have been honored with Michelin Keys for 2026. The prestigious awards recognize exceptional hospitality and stays.

headline: Congress Open to Grand Alliance in Goa
summary: AICC leader Venugopal stated that the Congress party is open to forming a grand opposition alliance in Goa. However, this depends on whether potential partners are sincere about defeating the BJP.

headline: Omkar the Elephant Returns to Mollem
summary: Wildlife authorities are grappling with a recurring situation as Omkar the elephant continues to frequent the Mollem area. The persistent visits have drawn significant attention.

headline: Bharati Pawar Named New BJP Goa In-Charge
summary: The Bharatiya Janata Party has reshuffled its state-level charges and appointed Bharati Pawar as the new in-charge for Goa. The transition is part of ongoing organizational updates.

headline: Voter Roll Row: 97 Names Allegedly Removed
summary: Objections have been raised before the Chief Election Commissioner over the alleged removal of 97 names from Goa's voter rolls. Opposition figures and activists are demanding a thorough inquiry.

headline: Horticulture Outlets Sell Subsidised Onions
summary: Following intervention over coconut prices, Goa's horticulture outlets have begun selling subsidised onions to help consumers cope with surging market rates. The move aims to provide relief to household budgets.

headline: Dry Spells Dim Mollem's Bioluminescence
summary: Recent dry spells have dimmed Mollem's famous bioluminescent glow and impacted the seasonal wildflower spectacle. Environmental factors have stunted the natural phenomenon this year.

headline: Carlo Ancelotti Comments on Brazil's Friendly Matches
summary: Football manager Carlo Ancelotti remarked that for the Brazilian national team, there is no such thing as a friendly game. Every match carries high expectations and competitive intensity.

headline: Goa CM Focuses on Female Voters Ahead of Polls
summary: The Goa Chief Minister is making a strategic pre-election push targeting female voters through direct aid programs. The initiative highlights high political stakes ahead of upcoming polls.

headline: Passenger Shares Vande Bharat Experience
summary: Actor Nauheed Cyrusi shared her pleasant eight-hour journey experience aboard the Mumbai-Goa Vande Bharat train. She highlighted the onboard amenities, including breakfast, snacks, and lunch.

headline: Labour Shortage Halts Cutbona Trawlers
summary: A severe labour shortage has left nearly 25% of fishing trawlers at the Cutbona jetty sitting idle. Trawler owners are struggling to find crew members as the situation impacts local fishing operations.

headline: Name Discrepancy Delays Kenyan's Bail Plea
summary: A discrepancy in names has complicated the bail plea of a Kenyan national involved in a 2023 trafficking case. The legal proceedings in the High Court have been temporarily affected.

headline: Ship-Shaped CoP Terminal Up for Private Deal
summary: The iconic ship-shaped Captain of Ports terminal building is being offered for a 30-year private lease agreement. Authorities aim to monetize the commercial potential of the waterfront asset.

headline: Maid Alleges Assault and Molestation
summary: A domestic worker has filed serious allegations of assault and molestation against her employer. Police have faced accusations from local advocates for allegedly refusing to register an FIR.

headline: Goa Sets 3-Year Afforestation Plan
summary: The Goa forest department has introduced a comprehensive three-year plan to clear the existing 246-hectare afforestation backlog. The project aims to boost green cover across designated tracts.

headline: Man Duped of Rs 1.85 Lakh by 'Friend'
summary: A resident of Poinguinim has lost Rs 1.85 lakh after being allegedly defrauded by an acquaintance. Local police have registered a case and launched a search for the accused.

headline: TCP Puts Brakes on Construction Around Pre-1961 Houses
summary: The Town and Country Planning department has introduced restrictions on new constructions surrounding houses built prior to 1961. The move seeks to protect heritage structures and prevent haphazard development.

headline: Atal Setu Route Reopened for Porvorim Traffic
summary: The Atal Setu route has been officially reopened for motorists travelling in the direction of Porvorim. The reopening is expected to ease traffic congestion on alternative routes.

headline: Chimbel Convent Among 15 Gems Recognized by State
summary: The historic Chimbel convent is among 15 cultural and architectural gems recently awarded a State shield. The recognition highlights their heritage significance in Goa.

headline: Congress Rally Causes Traffic Snarls
summary: The Congress party has launched a 27-day political rally across parts of Goa. The ongoing procession has resulted in heavy traffic snarls and inconvenienced daily commuters.

headline: Pedestrian Killed in Verna Road Mishap
summary: A tragic road accident in Verna claimed the life of a pedestrian. Local authorities are investigating the circumstances surrounding the fatal collision.

headline: HC Upholds Bail in Money Laundering Case
summary: The High Court has upheld the bail granted to a Kerala native, noting that he had no role in laundering funds exceeding Rs 12.88 lakh. Legal proceedings in the financial case will continue.

headline: Goa Faces 32% Rain Deficit and High Humidity
summary: Goa is experiencing unseasonably warm weather accompanied by a 32% rain deficit. Residents are enduring extreme feel-like temperatures amid prolonged dry conditions.

headline: Vijai Seeks Blessings Amid Alliance Talks
summary: Amid ongoing speculation and political discussions regarding alliances, Goa Forward Party chief Vijai Sardesai visited Ajmer and Pushkar to seek divine blessings.

headline: CM Sawant Offers Prayers at Sada Ganesh Pandal
summary: Goa Chief Minister Pramod Sawant visited the Murgaocha Raja Ganesh pandal in Sada to offer prayers. He participated in the ongoing festive celebrations with local residents.

headline: Burglars Steal Rs 15 Lakh Jewellery in Mencurem
summary: Burglars broke into a residential house in Mencurem and made off with gold and diamond jewellery worth approximately Rs 15 lakh. Police have registered a case of theft and are tracking the culprits.
